bounded_trace.policy: Inclusive spans may overlap. The trace stops after256 callbacks and does not attribute the entire case. A module-memory miss does not imply every native function compiled.

offline_comparison.policy: Generation-only exact harness sources, fixed validated strict ordinary-function caller with no private names/import record; minimal Intl profile. Relative byte comparison only, no actual callback witness or product execution/retention acceptance.

cache_io_probe.policy: Round-robin model over a closed diagnostic cache, not the actual callback key sequence. Other core native scopes ran on separate CPU assignments; these are diagnostic I/O samples, not end-to-end attribution or a speedup claim. Existing mtime recency writes are retained.

idle_timeout_controls.policy: Exact same test executable/fixtures/deadlines, existing bounded caches. Recovery is diagnostic; original three-failure whole-target outcome is retained. Cache warmth differs, so no exclusive contention attribution is inferred.

broader_native_template_target.policy: Original failed whole-target outcomes preserved. One separate-body arguments emission error, two native timeouts. Both timeout IDs pass serial idle controls; the successor arguments repair remains unaccepted. The full target must rerun.
